snippet.title: TRUDGE – Teaser
snippet.description:
The routine begins on September 8, 2026.

Wishlist TRUDGE on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4797280/TRUDGE/

Every day feels the same.
Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep.
In a silent city trapped in repetition, life drifts between routine, addiction, and quiet despair. 
Days blur together as the same streets, the same habits, and the same empty rhythm repeat without end.
Yet something begins to shift.
Break routines. Resist temptation. Follow unfamiliar paths. 
Seek meaning beneath the silence. Somewhere between exhaustion and longing, something begins to stir.
Will you escape the cycle, uncover what lies beneath, or surrender to something greater?
